block_size.description: Uniform block size in bytes for both IFILE and OFILE (conflicts with ibs/obs). For pt devices, must match device logical block size.

blocks_per_transfer.description: Number of input blocks per transfer buffer (BPT). Controls copy buffer size: IBS * BPT. Must satisfy ((IBS * BPT) % OBS == 0).

cdb_size.description: SCSI CDB size in bytes (0=auto, or 6,10,12,16,32). 0 uses auto-selection logic.

cmd_duration_limit.description: Command duration limit (CDL) value (0-7). 0 means no limit. Only effective with cdbsz >= 16.

continue_on_error.description: Continue copying despite input errors (coe=1). Not effective for output errors on regular files.

copy_blocks.description: Number of blocks to copy. -1 means 'all available'.

dry_run.description: Enable dry-run mode (--dry-run). Parses and validates arguments but skips actual I/O.

input_block_size.description: Input block size in bytes (conflicts with bs). Default: same as bs.

input_file.description: Input file/device path (required). Use '-' for stdin. Must be specified.

output_block_size.description: Output block size in bytes (conflicts with bs). Default: same as bs.

output_file.description: Output file/device path (optional). Defaults to /dev/null. Use '-' for stdout.

progress_report.description: Enable progress reporting (status=progress). Prints throughput/ETA periodically to stderr.

protect_read.description: RDPROTECT field for READ commands (0-7). Requires IFILE to be a pt device if >0.

protect_write.description: WRPROTECT field for WRITE commands (0-7). Requires OFILE to be a pt device if >0.

pt_access.description: Use SCSI pass-through (pt) access. Required for raw SCSI commands on devices that support both pt and standard I/O.

retries.description: Number of retries for transient SCSI errors on pt devices.

seek_blocks.description: Number of output blocks to seek before writing.

skip_blocks.description: Number of input blocks to skip before copying.

sparse_writes.description: Skip writing blocks that are entirely zero (sparse writes).

use_odx.description: Enable offloaded copy using ODX (XCOPY(LID4) subset).

use_xcopy.description: Enable offloaded copy using XCOPY(LID1) commands.

verbose_level.description: Verbose/diagnostic level (0-5). Higher values increase stderr output.

verify_mode.description: Enable verify mode (--verify). Compares IFILE and OFILE contents without copying.
